commands.command: cargo clippy --lib -- -D warnings -D unsafe_code -D clippy::unwrap_used -D clippy::expect_used -D clippy::panic -D clippy::todo -D clippy::unimplemented -D clippy::indexing_slicing -D clippy::get_unwrap -D clippy::arithmetic_side_effects -D clippy::as_conversions

rules_satisfied: No lossy as conversion (payload.len() as u32 replaced with u32::try_from)
max_payload bound enforced: rejects payloads exceeding max_payload limit
No unsafe, unwrap, expect, panic, todo, unimplemented, unreachable in production source
Pure core: encode_frame is deterministic with no I/O or side effects
Typed errors: FrameError::PayloadTooLarge and FrameError::Overflow used instead of panics
Two behavior tests pass: encodes and rejects_limit
Clippy passes with strict Holzman linting flags
residual_risk: max_payload is usize; if max_payload > u32::MAX, the overflow check on the actual payload length will catch it. The domain cap is inherently bounded by the system addressable space. No known residual risk.
